Don\'t want to self-host? The \"Free FRP Platforms\" card below offers OpenFrp / ChmlFrp / StarryFrp / SakuraFrp: register, fill the node address/port/Token into frpc.toml above, tap \"Start Tunnel\".
Simply a \"tunnel\": your phone connects to a server with a public IP via frp; others visit that server to reach your phone.
Rent a cheap cloud server from Aliyun, Tencent Cloud or Oracle Cloud (free ARM instances exist). Key requirement: a public IP.
Install frp Server on the Server
Login to the server, search fatedier/frp on GitHub, download the matching version, extract and edit frps.toml: bindPort = 7000, set auth.method and token
Fill the server public IP into \"frp server address\" above, port 7000, Token as set (must match server exactly).
Tap \"Start Tunnel\"; the app auto-installs the frp client and connects. First time installs via apt, wait a moment.
After starting, tell friends the server public IP and port (default 25565); enter IP:25565 in Minecraft \"Multiplayer\" to \"Direct Connect\".
Allow ports 7000 (frp) and 25565 (MC) in the firewall, or connections will fail. Set a Token to prevent abuse.
bore is a minimal TCP tunnel tool with only 3 message types. Phone side is pure Kotlin, no download, instant start.
Like frp, you need a VPS with a public IP. Search ekzhang/bore on GitHub, download the binary, run on the server: ./bore server
Fill the server IP and port (default 7835) above, e.g. your-vps.com:7835.
Tap \"Start Tunnel\"; the app connects to the bore server directly from phone network. No Termux, no download, starts in seconds.
The status card shows the public address (serverIP:port); copy and send to friends for MC Direct Connect.
Pros: ultra-lightweight (~300 lines), instant start. Limit: TCP only, self-hosted server required.
Don\'t want to self-host? Register on these free frp platforms and fill the node address/port/Token into frpc.toml above.
